comparisons.peer_summary: The company has a long history of operating in Asia, where it manufactures and sources the majority of its products and materials, and stores the majority of its product inventory in a warehouse in Malaysia.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom discuss their geographic manufacturing footprint as a core operational characteristic. Intel highlights manufacturing the majority of its products in its own facilities using proprietary technologies to optimize performance and scale. In contrast, Broadcom discloses a long history of operating in Asia where it manufactures and sources the majority of its products, placing it in close proximity to customers' manufacturing facilities. While both assert manufacturing 'majority' of products, Intel emphasizes internal proprietary capability, whereas Broadcom emphasizes geographic proximity in Asia.

sentences.text: We manufacture a majority of our products in our own manufacturing facilities using our proprietary process technologies.
This enables us to optimize performance, shorten time-to-market for new product introductions, and more quickly scale products in high volume.
We also have a long history of operating in Asia where we manufacture and source the majority of our products and materials.
We store the majority of our product inventory in our warehouse in Malaysia and our presence in Asia places us in close proximity to many of our customers' manufacturing facilities.
